arxiv-2102-04074.title: Learning Curve Theory
arxiv-2102-04074.creator: Marcus Hutter
arxiv-2102-04074.description: Abstract Recently a number of empirical “universal” scaling law papers have been published, most notably by OpenAI. ‘Scaling laws’ refers to power-law decreases of training or test error w.r.t. more data, larger neural networks, and/or more compute. In this work we focus on scaling w.r.t. data size n n .

arxiv-2106-06937.title: ACL-IJCNLP 2021 Common Sense Beyond English: Evaluating and Improving Multilingual Language Models for Commonsense Reasoning
arxiv-2106-06937.creator: Bill Yuchen Lin, Seyeon Lee, Xiaoyang Qiao, Xiang Ren
arxiv-2106-06937.description: Abstract Commonsense reasoning research has so far been mainly limited to English. We aim to evaluate and improve popular multilingual language models (ML-LMs) to help advance commonsense reasoning (CSR) beyond English. We collect the Mickey corpus, consisting of 561k sentences in 11 different languages, which can be used for analyzing and improving ML-LMs.

arxiv-2303-09975.title: MedNeXt: Transformer-driven Scaling of ConvNets for Medical Image Segmentation
arxiv-2303-09975.creator: Saikat Roy, Gregor Koehler, Constantin Ulrich, Michael Baumgartner, Jens Petersen, Fabian Isensee, Paul F. Jaeger, Klaus Maier-Hein
arxiv-2303-09975.description: Abstract There has been exploding interest in embracing Transformer-based architectures for medical image segmentation. However, the lack of large-scale annotated medical datasets make achieving performances equivalent to those in natural images challenging. Convolutional networks, in contrast, have higher inductive biases and consequently, are easily trainable to high performance.

arxiv-2309-15464.title: On staticity of bifurcate Killing horizons Thanks: Vienna preprint UWThPh 2023-12 Thanks: Email marc@usal.es
arxiv-2309-15464.creator: Piotr T. Chruściel
arxiv-2309-15464.description: Abstract We show that bifurcate Killing horizons with closed torsion form, in spacetimes of arbitrary dimension satisfying a Ricci-structure condition, arise from static Killing vectors. The result applies in particular to Λ \Lambda -vacuum spacetimes. 1 Introduction Stationary spacetimes are of particular physical importance as they describe equilibrium configurations of the gravitational field.

arxiv-2401-17447.title: Reversing information flow: retrodiction in semicartesian categories
arxiv-2401-17447.creator: Arthur J. Parzygnat
arxiv-2401-17447.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Arthur J. Parzygnat. In statistical inference, retrodiction is the act of inferring potential causes in the past based on knowledge of the effects in the present and the dynamics leading to the present. Retrodiction is applicable even when the dynamics is not reversible, and it agrees with the reverse dynamics when it exists, so that retrodiction may be viewed as an extension of inversion, i.e., time-reversal.

arxiv-2402-14074.title: Itinerant magnetism and magnetic polarons in the triangular lattice Hubbard model
arxiv-2402-14074.creator: Ivan Morera, Eugene Demler
arxiv-2402-14074.description: Abstract We use density matrix renormalization group to investigate the phase diagram of the Fermi Hubbard model on a triangular lattice with densities above half-filling, 1 ≤ n < 2 1\leq n<2 . We discuss the important role of kinetic magnetism and magnetic polarons.

arxiv-2405-05152.title: On equivalence of the Mellin-Barnes and the Givental integral representations of the Whittaker functions
arxiv-2405-05152.creator: A.A. Gerasimov, D.R. Lebedev, S.V. Oblezin
arxiv-2405-05152.description: Abstract . We construct an integral transformation intertwining the Gelfand-Tsetlin and the (modified) Gauss-Givental realizations of principle series representations of 𝔤 ​ 𝔩 3 ​ ( ℝ ) \mathfrak{gl}_{3}(\mathbb{R}) . This provides a direct identification of the corresponding integral representations for the 𝔤 ​ 𝔩 3 ​ ( ℝ ) \mathfrak{gl}_{3}(\mathbb{R}) -Whittaker function.

arxiv-2505-23728.title: Group Convolutional Neural Network Ground State of the Quantum Dimer Model
arxiv-2505-23728.creator: Ojasvi Sharma, Sandipan Manna, Prashant Shekhar Rao, G J Sreejith
arxiv-2505-23728.description: Abstract We estimate the ground state of the square lattice Quantum Dimer Model in a p4m \rm{p4m} -symmetric Group Convolutional Neural Network (GCNN) representation and show that results in agreement with exact diagonalization (ED) and quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) can be obtained with a ℒ = 2 \mathcal{L}=2 layer network.

arxiv-2508-00393.title: Predictions of dust continuum observations of circumplanetary disks with ngVLA: A case study of PDS 70 c
arxiv-2508-00393.creator: Yuhito Shibaike, Takahiro Ueda, Misato Fukagawa
arxiv-2508-00393.description: Abstract A gas giant forms a small gas disk called a “circumplanetary disk (CPD)” around the planet during its gas accretion process. The small gas disk contains dust particles like those in a protoplanetary disk, and these particles could be the building material of large moons.

arxiv-2510-05865.title: The Safety Challenge of World Models for Embodied AI Agents: A Review
arxiv-2510-05865.creator: Lorenzo Baraldi, Zifan Zeng, Chongzhe Zhang, Aradhana Nayak, Hongbo Zhu, Feng Liu, Qunli Zhang, Peng Wang, Shiming Liu, Zheng Hu, Angelo Cangelosi, Lorenzo Baraldi
arxiv-2510-05865.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Lorenzo Baraldi, Zifan Zeng, Chongzhe Zhang, Aradhana Nayak, Hongbo Zhu, Feng Liu, Qunli Zhang, Peng Wang, Shiming Liu, Zheng Hu, Angelo Cangelosi, Lorenzo Baraldi. The rapid progress in embodied artificial intelligence has highlighted the necessity for more advanced and integrated models that can perceive, interpret, and predict environmental dynamics. In this context, World Models (WMs) have been introduced to provide embodied agents with the abilities to anticipate future environmental states and fill in knowledge gaps, thereby enhancing agents’ ability to plan and execute actions.

britannica-1911-cyclostyle.title: Cyclostyle (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-cyclostyle.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-cyclostyle.description: Article 'Cyclostyle' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 7), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. a term used in architecture. A structure composed of a circular range of columns without a core is cyclostylar; with a core the range would be peristyle. This is the species of edifice called by Vitruvius monopteral.

pmc-11442944.creator: Tafirenyika Gwenzi, Petra Schrotz-King, Sophie C. Anker, Ben Schöttker, Michael Hoffmeister, Hermann Brenner
pmc-11442944.description: BackgroundPost-operative anaemia is linked to iron deficiency. We investigated the prognostic value of post-operative iron biomarkers in colorectal cancer (CRC).MethodsFerritin, transferrin, iron, and transferrin saturation (TS%) were measured from blood collected at a single time-point post-surgery in 2769 CRC patients.

pmc-11473298.title: Seven-tesla magnetic resonance imaging of the nervus terminalis, olfactory tracts, and olfactory bulbs in COVID-19 patients with anosmia and hypogeusia
pmc-11473298.creator: Claudia F. E. Kirsch, Syed Ali Khurram, Daniel Lambert, Puneet Belani, Puneet S. Pawha, Akbar Alipour, Shams Rashid, Mackenzie T. Herb, Sera Saju, Yijuan Zhu, Bradley N. Delman, Hung-Mo Lin, Priti Balchandani
pmc-11473298.description: IntroductionLinking olfactory epithelium to the central nervous system are cranial nerve 1, the olfactory nerve, and cranial nerve “0,” and the nervus terminalis (NT). Since there is minimal expression of angiotensin-converting enzyme-2 (ACE-2) in the olfactory nerve, it is unclear how SARS-CoV-2 causes anosmia (loss of smell) and hypogeusia (reduction of taste).

pmc-11678486.title: Label Accuracy and Quality of Select Weight-Loss Dietary Supplements Sold on or near US Military Bases
pmc-11678486.creator: Cindy Crawford, Andrea T. Lindsey, Bharathi Avula, Kumar Katragunta, Ikhlas A. Khan, Patricia A. Deuster
pmc-11678486.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background/Objectives: Sixty-eight percent of service members are living with overweight or obesity, some who may not consult a healthcare provider when they decide to lose weight. Instead, they often turn to weight-loss dietary supplements for self-care solutions. The purpose of this case series study was to examine the label accuracy and quality of select weight-loss dietary supplements sold on or near US military bases across the country.

pmc-13084971.title: Health care discrimination and self‐reported health in transgender, gender nonconforming, and nonbinary individuals with cancer
pmc-13084971.creator: Daniel Sabater Minarim, Kaitlyn Lew, Suraj Rajan, Kylie M. Morgan, Sakshith Reddy Chintala, Jennifer T. Anger, Carol Y. Ochoa‐Dominguez, Matthew P. Banegas, Brent S. Rose, Paul Riviere

pmc-13178702.title: A concept analysis of the term midwifery intervention: A scoping review
pmc-13178702.creator: Marianne J. Nieuwenhuijze, Helga Gottfreðsdóttir
pmc-13178702.description: INTRODUCTIONThe term midwifery intervention or midwife intervention regularly occurs in scientific literature, without consistent understanding of what it implies. In modern maternity care where new technological interventions are constantly applied in practice, it is important to identify how interventions can be built on midwifery knowledge and its philosophy of care.
